comment: * This class contains all the possible override allowed states.

variables.name: DISABLED_NOT_DEBUGGABLE
variables.comment: * Change cannot be overridden, due to the app not being debuggable.

variables.name: DISABLED_NON_TARGET_SDK
variables.comment:
* Change cannot be overridden, due to the build being non-debuggable and the change being
     * enabled regardless of targetSdk.

variables.name: DISABLED_TARGET_SDK_TOO_HIGH
variables.comment: * Change cannot be overridden, due to the app's targetSdk being above the change's targetSdk.

variables.name: DEFERRED_VERIFICATION
variables.comment: * Change override decision is currently being deferred, due to the app not being installed yet.

variables.name: LOGGING_ONLY_CHANGE
variables.comment: * Change is marked as logging only, and cannot be toggled.

variables.name: PLATFORM_TOO_OLD
variables.comment: * Change is gated by a target sdk version newer than the current platform sdk version.

methods.name: public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
public void enforce(long changeId, String packageName) throws SecurityException
methods.comment:
* Enforces the policy for overriding compat changes.
     *
     * @param changeId    the change id that was attempted to be overridden.
     * @param packageName the package for which the attempt was made.
     * @throws SecurityException if the policy forbids this operation.

methodNames: public void writeToParcel(Parcel out, int flags)
